baseline.rationale: The baseline commit introduced the prior cue inventory and contains the audited 301 tracked audio files: 150 Clara MP3s, 150 Marcus MP3s, and one SFX WAV. HEAD has the same tracked audio tree hash; current additions are untracked worktree files.

verdict.nextAction: Freeze further audio generation, reconcile the current untracked Movement Profile V2/V2.1 asset and manifest set against the V2.1 manifest, then rerun the runtime timing audit for the changed Movement Profile V2 controller path.

summary.exactNextAction: Reconcile current Movement Profile V2/V2.1 cue assets, manifests, source text, and preview-pack status, then rerun the runtime timing audit for the changed MPV2 controller before any further audio generation or integrated preview.

runtimeArchitectureComparison.claim: Runtime uses bundled audio rather than runtime TTS.
runtimeArchitectureComparison.evidence: src/audio/voicePlayer.ts imports expo-audio and static manifests; scripts/generate-audio.ts is the only ElevenLabs caller.

runtimeArchitectureComparison.claim: One voice sequence plays at a time.
runtimeArchitectureComparison.evidence: VoiceChannel has one AudioPlayer, pendingCues, playing, and currentPriority.

runtimeArchitectureComparison.claim: Lower/equal-priority incoming speech is dropped while busy; higher priority interrupts.
runtimeArchitectureComparison.evidence: VoiceChannel.speak policy remains, but voicePriority now has MPV2/V2.1 branches and MPV2 definitions carry priority 50-100.
resolveVoiceCueAsset now fails closed for safety and Movement Profile V2 cues; playCue catches missing assets and playback-start failures without leaving the channel busy.

runtimeArchitectureComparison.claim: Assessment countdown and active timing path.
runtimeArchitectureComparison.evidence: Legacy SessionController still frame-timestamp-gates countdown, but MovementProfileV2CheckUpScreen emits initial speech from React effects and subsequent speech from timer/user-action transitions.
VoiceChannel.stop() releases player, clears pendingCues, sets playing false, resets priority.

runtimeArchitectureComparison.claim: Voice id captured by channel construction.
runtimeArchitectureComparison.evidence: VoiceChannel constructor normalizes and stores readonly voiceId.

runtimeArchitectureComparison.claim: Audio mode configuration does not interrupt camera.
runtimeArchitectureComparison.evidence: configureSessionAudio uses playsInSilentMode true, mixWithOthers, allowsRecording false, background false, earpiece false.

voiceParity.semanticParity: source_parity_verified; listening still required for new binaries

v21Reconciliation.exactScript: Time to train. I will guide the setup, work, and rests. Follow my voice and pause whenever you need.
Clear the space around you. Stop for sharp pain, dizziness, or feeling unwell.
Step into view so your whole body is visible.
I need a clearer view. Make sure your whole body is visible.
Move to the centre of the view.
Please turn on the main light.
Pause. Return to the setup position.
You're back in position. We'll restart.
Check-up complete. Your results are ready.
Use a sturdy chair that will not slide.
Keep sturdy support within easy reach.
Use the lowest stable step, with support nearby.
Check the band first and keep it away from your face.
Use a secure closed door anchor and test light tension first.
Move down to the floor and settle into the start position.
Can you safely get down to the floor and back up without assistance?
Feet-together hold. Stand with feet together, fingertips near support, eyes open.
Start on your left leg. Lift your right foot slightly.
Start on your right leg. Lift your left foot slightly.
Place your left foot in front, heel to toe.
Place your right foot in front, heel to toe.
Band pull-apart. Hold a light band at chest height. Pull your hands wide, then return slowly.
Supported split squat. Keep fingertips near support.
Left foot forward, small split stance.
Right foot forward, small split stance.
Bridge hold. Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat. Lift your hips and hold.
Glute bridge. Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat. Lift your hips, then lower with control.
Heel raise. Stand tall. Rise onto the balls of your feet, then lower slowly.
Supported heel raise. Fingertips near support. Rise onto the balls of your feet, then lower slowly.
Hip hinge. Feet under hips. Send hips back with a long spine, then stand tall.
Wall-tap hinge. Stand a step from the wall. Send hips back to tap the wall, then stand tall.
March in place. Stand tall near support and march with a steady rhythm.
Loaded sit-to-stand. Hold the load close to your chest. Stand fully, then sit with control.
Mini-band lateral walk. Band above your knees. Take small controlled steps both directions.
Neck rotations. Face the phone, sit or stand tall, and slowly look over one shoulder, then the other.
Move slowly until I say stop.
Band overhead press. Stand tall with light band tension. Press overhead, then return slowly.
Overhead reach. Stand tall. Reach both arms overhead as far as comfortable, then lower.
Incline push-up. Hands on a stable counter or sturdy chair. Lower in with control, then press away.
Push-up. Start from the floor position. Lower with control, then press up.
Wall push-up. Hands on the wall. Lower in with control, then press away.
Seated band row. Sit tall with the band anchored under both feet. Pull elbows back, then return slowly.
Seated hamstring reach. Sit tall at the chair edge.
Reach gently and hold until I say relax.
Extend your left leg, heel on the floor.
Extend your right leg, heel on the floor.
Squat. Feet about hip width. Lower as if to sit, then stand with control.
Loaded squat. Hold the load close to your chest. Lower into a squat, then stand with control.
Slow-lower squat. Lower slowly, then stand with control.
Supported squat. Stand near sturdy support. Lower as if to sit, then stand with control.
Standing band row. Face the secure door anchor in a stable stance. Pull elbows back, then return slowly.
Step-up. Use the lowest stable step with support nearby. Alternate the leading leg each rep, returning both feet to the floor.
Step-up. Alternate the leading leg each rep.
Cushion sit-to-stand. Sit tall on the cushion, feet flat. Stand fully, then sit with control.
Power sit-to-stand. Sit tall, drive up briskly to standing, then sit with control.
Slow-lower sit-to-stand. Stand fully, then lower slowly and steadily before the next rep.
Sit-to-stand. Sit tall in the middle of the chair, feet flat. Stand fully, then sit with control.
Supported hip-flexor stretch. Keep fingertips near support.
Step your left foot forward and shift gently into the stretch.
Step your right foot forward and shift gently into the stretch.
Supported side step. Stand near a counter. Step to the side, bring the other foot in, and continue with control.
Thoracic rotation. Sit or stand tall with arms crossed. Rotate one way, return to center, then rotate the other way.
Supported toe raise. Keep heels down, lift the front of your feet, then lower slowly.
Wall calf stretch. Hands on the wall.
Step your left leg back, heel down.
Step your right leg back, heel down.
Chair stand. Sit in the middle of a sturdy chair, side-on to the phone.
Cross your arms. When I say go, stand fully and sit with control until I say time.
Balance check. Keep support within easy reach. I will guide each stance.
Feet together. Eyes open. Keep support within reach.
Semi-tandem. Slide one foot half a step forward. Eyes open.
Tandem. Place one foot directly in front, heel to toe. Eyes open.
Single-leg. Stand on your selected leg and lift the other foot slightly.
Turn so your left side is nearest the phone.
Turn so your right side is nearest the phone.
Raise your left arm as high as comfortable. Hold there until I say relax.
Raise your right arm as high as comfortable. Hold there until I say relax.
Slowly fold from your hips and reach toward the floor. Hold there until I say stand tall.
Five quick chair stands. Arms crossed. Stand and sit five times as quickly as safely comfortable.
Quick balance check. Stand on your left leg with support nearby. Hold as long as comfortable.
Quick balance check. Stand on your right leg with support nearby. Hold as long as comfortable.
Quick mobility check. Extend your left leg and reach gently until I say relax.
Quick mobility check. Extend your right leg and reach gently until I say relax.
Keep holding, and gently close your eyes.
You can open your eyes now.
Up and go. Use the custom beta setup for this walking check.
When I say go, stand, walk the marked path, turn, walk back, and sit.
